audit_items.proof_trace: VerifyDataColumnSidecar validates only that len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) > 0 and that array lengths match, but never checks len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) <= MaxBlobsPerBlock(epoch). Spec requires assertion len(body.blob_kzg_commitments) <= get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block per specrefs/functions.yml:6110. This validation exists for blob sidecars (validate_beacon_blocks.go:329) but is missing for data column sidecars.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends data column sidecar via P2P with len(KzgCommitments) exceeding max_blobs_per_block for the epoch. The sidecar passes ValidFields check and enters verification pipeline, potentially causing resource exhaustion or state inconsistency when processing oversized commitment arrays.
